issue.title: Port the full shipping design token set to the native app
issue.body:
**Parity unit U1** of the native UI port. The RN app must match the shipping Svelte/Capacitor app. **What to build:** | # | Primitive to build in RN | Shipping source | Tokens / specifics to port | |---|---|---|---| | P1 | Full token set (extend the `rsdTokenSource` generator) | `web/src/lib/design/tokens.ts`, `tokenUsage.ts` | All of these, as light/dark pairs where themed:
• **Color:** `--surface`, `--surface-2`, `--surface-hover`, `--control-track`, `--brand`, `--brand-solid`, `--brand-solid-hover`, `--brand-text`, `--brand-wash` (+`-hover`), `--on-brand`, `--danger-wash` / `--danger-text`, `--success-*`, `--warning-*`, `--text-strong` / `--text` / `--text-soft`, `--label-ink`, `--icon-ink` / `--icon-muted`, `--border`, `--border-warm` (+`-strong`), `--float-surface` / `--float-border` / `--float-shadow`, `--paper`, `--dark-ink-keyline`, `--clear-gradient-rest`, `--polaroid-paper` / `--polaroid-ink`, scrim inks.
• **Spacing:** `--space-1..8`.
• **Radius:** `--radius-sm/md/lg/pill`, `--radius-blob-1/2/3`.
• **Type:** `--font-size-xs..xl`, `--font-size-display`, weights 500/600/700.
• **Shadow:** `--shadow-control`, `--shadow-pop`.
• **Motion:** `--duration-*`, `--ease-pop` / `-glide` / `-drawer`.
• **Other:** `--disabled-opacity`, `--touch-target-min` (48), `--modal-gutter`, `--setting-icon-size` (20), `--setting-indent`. | **Done when:** the primitive exists in `experiments/native-architecture` with light and dark values drift-guarded against the shipping source (imported or read by a test, never hand-copied). The PR includes a specimen screenshot next to the shipping `/design` styleguide rendering of the same primitive. No visible surface changes yet, except where a caller adopting the primitive is in this unit's scope. Shipping is the spec. Read the shipping component first, then match it. The `design` skill names the vocabulary. The parity inventory that produced this issue (2026-10-13) captured screenshot pairs in `/tmp/splotch-parity/` on the build host; regenerate any you need. Part of #2690.
